propositions: Top-level CLI help (overview.txt) and ticket-model.md documented unlink as taking no relation argument, contradicting the current optional relation-scoped unlink accepted by the public library and CLI.

Commit 73abb5805f added optional relation-scoped unlink to core/library/CLI and updated subcommand help and user guides, but omitted the independently maintained overview.txt and ticket-model.md surfaces.

Documentation must clarify that explicit canonical relation removal targets exactly that relation while preserving other active relations on the pair, and that omitted relation falls back to most-recent.
Event-schema.md operation wording must distinguish optional relation operation selection from the emitted link_uuid-targeted UNLINK event cancellation.
